subject: Finalizing evaluation and deployment path — timeline & MAP
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura@healthbridge.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed MAP & evaluation timeline for deployment mode decision

Laura —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation I attached an updated MAP that focuses on the deployment-mode decision (hosted vs dedicated vs private) plus a short evaluation timetable. High level ask: can HealthBridge confirm which of the three constraints below matters most for the PoC so we can bias the MAP and tests accordingly?

- Latency budget (95th percentile) per request
- Regulatory constraints (data residency / VPC requirement)
- Cost / run-rate target for production (monthly)

Suggested next steps (week-by-week):
1) This week: finalize MAP roles and acceptance criteria (you + procurement) — attach RBW-5421-MAP-v3.pdf
2) Next 2 weeks: PoC evaluation (hosted -> dedicated staging) with perf runs in US-East
3) Week 4: cross-check SOC2 evidence and finalize contract / region selection

Can you confirm that timeline works for your side? If helpful, I can loop Marco from our cloud integrations team to scope region-specific network checks.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: RBW-5421-MAP-v3.pdf (MAP, 3 pages)
From: Laura Chen <laura@healthbridge.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed MAP & evaluation timeline for deployment mode decision

Naomi —

Thanks, this looks sensible. A couple of clarifying items from our side before we lock the MAP: 

- Our compliance team will need a SOC2 summary and a quick note on data residency for the dedicated option (we prefer US-East but need confirmation on persistence/backups).
- For the PoC we want reproductions of 95th-pct latency at both typical and peak QPS — can Redwood provide a short test harness or traffic spec we can run?
- Procurement will want a draft SOW and a cost snapshot for a 6-month committed Dedicated pool (numbers are fine as ranges).

If you can send SOC2-summary-2027.pdf and a sample traffic spec we’ll share with legal & infra. Also please include the DocuSign link when contract draft is ready.

Laura
VP Product
HealthBridge AI

- Clarify data retention periods for logs (we prefer 90 days by default)

Cc: Procurement <procurement@healthbridge.ai>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Decision & next steps: Dedicated pool, US-East, 8-week close cadence

Naomi / team —

Quick update from our side: after internal review we’re ready to commit to the Dedicated pool option (US-East) for the PoC and short-term production, contingent on: SOC2 evidence (summary acceptable), confirmation that backups are encrypted and geo-located in US-East, and an executed SOW. Procurement will route the DocuSign envelope once we resolve the redlines you sent.

Timeline request from HealthBridge: 
- Week 0 (this week): confirm SOC2-summary-2027.pdf + answers to backup retention/location question
- Weeks 1–2: perf PoC in Dedicated staging (Ben’s traffic spec)
- Weeks 3–4: contract finalization and sign-off (DocuSign)
- Weeks 5–8: ramp to small production (migration assistance from Redwood)

Please confirm you can meet this 8-week cadence and I’ll tell execs we have a runway. If ok, please share the SOC2 summary and RBW-5421-MAP-v3.pdf annotated with acceptance criteria by end of today.

Laura
VP Product
HealthBridge AI
